topics.label_zh: 全国碳排放权交易市场

records.title_zh: 2025年全国碳市场覆盖3378家重点排放单位
records.title_en: China's national carbon market covered 3,378 key emitting entities in 2025
records.summary_zh: 2025年全国碳排放权交易市场覆盖发电、钢铁、水泥和铝冶炼四个行业，共纳入3378家重点排放单位，全年运行243个交易日；全国自愿减排市场同期发布12项新方法学。
records.summary_en: In 2025, China's national ETS covered 3,378 key emitters across power generation, steel, cement and aluminium smelting and operated for 243 trading days. The national voluntary market also added 12 methodologies.
records.source_zh: 中华人民共和国生态环境部
records.source_en: Ministry of Ecology and Environment of China

records.title_zh: 生态环境部披露跨境碳交易制度研究方向
records.title_en: China outlines work on a cross-border carbon trading regime
records.summary_zh: 生态环境部表示，中国正在结合《巴黎协定》第六条规则和国内实际研究跨境碳交易管理制度。同期披露的数据显示，截至2025年6月底，全国碳排放配额累计成交6.69亿吨、成交额459.29亿元，核证自愿减排量累计成交219.38万吨。
records.summary_en: China's environment ministry said it is studying a cross-border carbon trading regime consistent with Article 6 and national circumstances. By June 2025, cumulative ETS trading reached 669 million tonnes and RMB 45.929 billion; verified voluntary reductions traded reached 2.1938 million tonnes.
records.source_zh: 中华人民共和国生态环境部
records.source_en: Ministry of Ecology and Environment of China

records.title_zh: 中央文件明确全国碳市场2027年和2030年建设目标
records.title_en: China sets 2027 and 2030 milestones for its national carbon market
records.summary_zh: 文件提出，到2027年全国碳排放权交易市场基本覆盖工业领域主要排放行业；到2030年基本建成以总量控制为基础、免费与有偿分配相结合的市场，并形成透明、规范、与国际接轨的自愿减排市场。
records.summary_en: The guideline calls for the national ETS to cover all major industrial emitting sectors by 2027. By 2030, it aims for a cap-based market combining free and paid allocation and a transparent, standardised voluntary market aligned with international standards.

records.title_en: Progress Report of China's National Carbon Market (2025)
records.summary_zh: 报告系统梳理强制碳市场、自愿减排市场、配额分配、核算核查和数据基础设施。报告指出，中国正研究符合国情的跨境碳交易管理办法，并拟规范其他自愿减排机制向第六条机制转换的管理要求。
records.summary_en: The official report reviews the national ETS, voluntary market, allocation, MRV and data infrastructure. It says China is studying cross-border trading rules suited to national circumstances and rules for converting reductions from other voluntary mechanisms into Article 6 units.
records.source_zh: 中华人民共和国生态环境部
records.source_en: Ministry of Ecology and Environment of China

records.title_zh: 钢铁、水泥和铝冶炼行业纳入全国碳市场
records.title_en: China expands its national ETS to steel, cement and aluminium smelting
records.summary_zh: 经国务院批准，钢铁、水泥、铝冶炼三个行业纳入全国碳排放权交易市场，覆盖二氧化碳、四氟化碳和六氟化二碳，成为全国碳市场启动后的首次行业扩围。
records.summary_en: With State Council approval, steel, cement and aluminium smelting entered the national ETS, covering carbon dioxide, carbon tetrafluoride and hexafluoroethane in the market's first sectoral expansion.
records.source_zh: 中华人民共和国生态环境部
records.source_en: Ministry of Ecology and Environment of China

records.title_zh: 2025年全国碳市场明确名录、数据质量、配额与清缴安排
records.title_en: China sets the 2025 national ETS schedule for coverage, data quality, allocation and compliance
records.summary_zh: 年度工作通知要求发电、钢铁、水泥和铝冶炼行业中年直接排放达到2.6万吨二氧化碳当量的单位纳入重点排放单位名录，并通过管理平台推进排放报告、核查、配额分配和清缴。
records.summary_en: The annual notice places facilities in power, steel, cement and aluminium smelting with direct annual emissions of at least 26,000 tCO2e on the key-emitter list and sets the reporting, verification, allocation and compliance workflow.
records.source_zh: 中华人民共和国生态环境部
records.source_en: Ministry of Ecology and Environment of China

records.title_zh: 产品碳足迹国家通则GB/T 24067—2024发布
records.title_en: China publishes national standard GB/T 24067-2024 on product carbon footprints
records.summary_zh: 该标准修改采用ISO 14067:2018，规定产品碳足迹量化要求和指南，2024年10月1日起实施，为重点产品核算规则、碳标识认证和企业供应链数据衔接提供通用基础。
records.summary_en: The standard modifies and adopts ISO 14067:2018 and took effect on 1 October 2024. It provides a common basis for product-level accounting rules, carbon-label certification and supply-chain data.
records.source_zh: 全国标准信息公共服务平台
records.source_en: National Public Service Platform for Standards Information

agencies.name_en: Ministry of Sustainability and the Environment

records.title_zh: 新加坡与老挝签署《巴黎协定》第六条碳信用实施协议
records.title_en: Singapore and Lao PDR sign an Article 6 implementation agreement on carbon credits
records.summary_zh: 2026年9月4日，新加坡与老挝签署《巴黎协定》第六条下的碳信用实施协议，进一步扩大新加坡政府间碳信用合作网络。
records.summary_en: On 4 September 2026, Singapore and Lao PDR signed an implementation agreement on carbon credits under Article 6 of the Paris Agreement, further expanding Singapore's government-to-government carbon-credit network.

records.title_zh: 新加坡已与11个国家签署第六条碳信用实施协议
records.title_en: Singapore has signed Article 6 implementation agreements with 11 countries
records.summary_zh: 截至2026年6月，新加坡已与巴布亚新几内亚、加纳、不丹、智利、秘鲁、卢旺达、巴拉圭、泰国、越南、蒙古和菲律宾签署实施协议，并要求相应调整、独立核算和避免重复计算。
records.summary_en: As of June 2026, Singapore had signed implementation agreements with 11 countries. Its framework requires corresponding adjustments, robust independent accounting and avoidance of double counting.
records.source_zh: 新加坡国家气候变化秘书处

records.title_zh: 新加坡政府与自愿碳市场诚信委员会深化合作
records.title_en: Singapore Government and ICVCM deepen partnership on high-integrity carbon markets
records.summary_zh: 双方将围绕可信、可互操作和高完整性的碳市场开展能力建设与知识共享，并推进新加坡、肯尼亚和英国共同主持的扩大碳市场联盟工作。
records.summary_en: The agreement covers capacity building and knowledge sharing for credible, interoperable and high-integrity carbon markets and supports the Coalition to Grow Carbon Markets co-chaired by Singapore, Kenya and the United Kingdom.
records.source_zh: 新加坡国家气候变化秘书处

records.title_zh: 新加坡启动2026气候适应年并推进首份国家适应计划
records.title_en: Singapore launches the Year of Climate Adaptation and develops its first National Adaptation Plan
records.summary_zh: 副总理颜金勇表示，新加坡将首份国家适应计划作为应对高温、洪涝、水资源压力和海平面上升的长期动态路线图；政府把2026年确定为气候适应年。
records.summary_en: Deputy Prime Minister Gan Kim Yong described Singapore's first National Adaptation Plan as a long-term living roadmap for heat, floods, water stress and sea-level rise. The government designated 2026 as the Year of Climate Adaptation.

records.title_zh: 新加坡允许结转2025排放年度未使用的国际碳信用额度
records.title_en: Singapore allows unused 2025 international carbon credit offsets to be carried forward
records.summary_zh: 纳税设施每年可用合格国际碳信用抵销最多5%的应税排放。因第六条信用供给仍需时间形成，2025年度未使用额度可按25新元与45新元碳税税率换算后结转至2026年度。
records.summary_en: Taxable facilities may use eligible international carbon credits for up to 5% of taxable emissions. Unused 2025 capacity can be converted at the S$25-to-S$45 carbon-tax ratio and carried into 2026 while Article 6 supply develops.
records.source_zh: 新加坡国家环境局与永续发展与环境部
records.source_en: National Environment Agency and Ministry of Sustainability and the Environment

records.title_zh: 新加坡能源转型聚焦电力进口、太阳能与低碳技术储备
records.title_en: Singapore's energy transition focuses on power imports, solar and readiness for low-carbon technologies
records.summary_zh: 能源市场管理局提出在可靠、可负担和减排之间保持平衡：2030年太阳能目标为2吉瓦峰值，2035年前计划进口约6吉瓦低碳电力，并评估碳捕集封存、地热等技术。
records.summary_en: EMA's approach balances reliability, affordability and emissions reduction. Singapore targets 2 GWp of solar by 2030, around 6 GW of low-carbon electricity imports by 2035, and is assessing CCS and geothermal options.
records.source_zh: 新加坡能源市场管理局

records.title_zh: 新加坡、黄金标准与Verra发布第6.2条碳信用协议
records.title_en: Singapore, Gold Standard and Verra publish the Article 6.2 Crediting Protocol
records.summary_zh: 协议为政府使用独立信用机制的登记、监测报告核查、签发和管理基础设施提供标准化路径，旨在降低政府与项目开发方落实第6.2条合作的不确定性。
records.summary_en: The protocol provides a standardised route for governments to use independent crediting infrastructure for registration, MRV, issuance and management, reducing uncertainty in Article 6.2 cooperation.
records.source_zh: 新加坡国家气候变化秘书处

records.title_zh: 新加坡采购217.5万吨第六条自然类碳信用
records.title_en: Singapore will procure 2.175 million tonnes of Article 6-aligned nature-based carbon credits
records.summary_zh: 国家气候变化秘书处和贸工部将从加纳、秘鲁和巴拉圭四个项目采购217.5万吨高质量自然类碳信用，用于实现2030年国家自主贡献；采购合同总值约7600万新元。
records.summary_en: NCCS and MTI will procure 2.175 million tonnes of high-quality nature-based credits from four projects in Ghana, Peru and Paraguay for Singapore's 2030 NDC, at an approximate value of S$76 million.
records.source_zh: 新加坡国家气候变化秘书处与贸工部
records.source_en: National Climate Change Secretariat and Ministry of Trade and Industry
